_doc: The angle family of plain sections, with a starting size (25 x 25 x 3 mm, al6063-t5): an angle (an l): two legs meeting at the lower left corner. A plain section has no slots and no maker's sheet: give the size, the wall and the material you have (profileModel('angle', { width: 40, height: 25, wall: 3 })), and its area, second moments, torsion constant and mass are worked out from its outline. It is fastened through drilled holes, clamps and printed saddles. The drawn outline leaves out the round in the root between the legs and at their toes.
name: profile-angle

family.rule: An angle (an L): two legs meeting at the lower left corner
family.source: a starting value of the kit's: give your own with profileModel(family, { width, height, wall, material }) or in a set of your own

width.rule: The leg along the bottom, to start from
width.source: a starting value of the kit's: give your own with profileModel(family, { width, height, wall, material }) or in a set of your own

height.rule: The leg up the side, to start from
height.source: a starting value of the kit's: give your own with profileModel(family, { width, height, wall, material }) or in a set of your own

wall.rule: Thickness of both legs, to start from
wall.source: a starting value of the kit's: give your own with profileModel(family, { width, height, wall, material }) or in a set of your own

material.rule: Extruded aluminium, EN AW-6063 T5: one of the alloys such sections are extruded in (6060 and 6063 in Europe, 6061 and 6063 in America). Name the alloy on your supplier's sheet where it matters
